summary: Alterity Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K announcing its CEO David Stamler will present at the 46th Annual Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference on August 11, 2026. This is a routine investor-relations event notice, not a special situation. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved. The filing simply provides conference participation details and forward-looking statements regarding its drug development program for ATH434 in Multiple System Atrophy. The event is a standard corporate presentation at an industry conference.
